# ORVN Labs

> ORVN Labs builds software for how real estate gets presented. LAREI, its current
> product, gives wholesalers, agents, investors and operators one professional home
> for their brand, property portfolio and published property pages. LAREI is in
> private beta. PAS, an earlier ORVN Labs product, is archived.

ORVN Labs is a small software company. Its current product is LAREI: a workspace for
professional websites, property portfolios and shareable property pages, with
AI-assisted drafts that stay under the user's review. The site is light (bone and
white) with a dark pine footer and lime accents. Contact: hello@orvnlabs.com.

## LAREI in brief

- Professional presence: a business page with who you are, the markets you serve,
  contact details and the properties you choose to show.
- Property portfolio: one record per property, with the facts, photographs and
  documents you have approved.
- Responsible AI: AI drafts from your material. You review facts and decide what
  publishes. LAREI does not verify real-estate facts automatically.
- Brand voice: approved context and examples shape tone and vocabulary without
  changing the underlying facts.
- Observable activity: views, tracked clicks and inquiries on published pages.
  Anonymous visitors are not identified.
- Status: private beta, invitation only. Pricing has not been announced. Screens and
  sample listings shown on the site are illustrative.

## ORVN Labs facts

- Company: ORVN Labs.
- Current product: LAREI.
- Earlier product: PAS (first-contact response for brokerages), archived and not
  part of the LAREI beta. The page remains online for old links.
- Audience: wholesalers, agents, investors and real-estate operators and teams.
- No public pricing, no customer counts and no performance claims are published.

## Diagnostics

- The Lead Leakage Scorecard and Revenue Recovery Calculator run locally in the
  browser, with no signup. They are general tools, not LAREI features, and their
  outputs are estimates from the numbers you enter.
